<Region> Pilgrimage - Walking Tour
Tour-Category: walking

Stop 1: <Pagoda>

Coordinates: 10.1000, 106.1000

Type/Specialty: Pagoda

After his death in 1887, his followers established the lower <Pagoda>. A bronze bell hangs near the gate. The courtyard is shaded by old trees. Incense drifts from the main hall.

Directions: Walk uphill to the statue.

Stop 2: <Statue>

Coordinates: 10.1100, 106.1100

Type/Specialty: Statue

This reclining Gautama Buddha statue is the largest reclining Buddha in all of <Region>. The statue lies on its right side facing the valley. It measures 49 meters in length. Pilgrims leave flowers at its feet.

Directions: Continue to the mountain.

Stop 3: <Mountain>

Coordinates: 10.1200, 106.1200

Type/Specialty: Mountain

<Mountain> Mount is a mountain located off National Route 1. It rises above the coast near <Town>. The summit trail starts behind the lower gate. Mist often covers the upper slope.

That's 3 stops in all.
